data.one_liner: Add developer contact info and social links into your Flutter app with ease.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-made widgets like ContactUs and ContactUsBottomAppBar to display company details, phone numbers, emails, and social media handles. Clicking any item automatically launches the corresponding app or web page.
use_when: You need to quickly build an About Us or Contact page for your app.
You want to display social media and contact links that open respective apps or web pages on click.
avoid_when: You require complex, custom layouts for contact cards that do not fit the pre-built widget structure.
You need backend integration for sending contact form submissions directly from the app.
strengths: Saves time by providing pre-built widgets for standard contact details and social handles.
Built-in URL launching for phone numbers, emails, websites, and social media profiles.
Supports custom fonts, colors, and bottom navigation bar integration.
weaknesses: Limited to predefined fields and layout structures provided by the package.
Relies entirely on external URL launching without built-in in-app browser options or fallback handling.
